rows.text: Everybody’s missing Tao’s whole point. Imagine an AI-generated cancer drug that’s specifically designed to game the drug trial process. We *already* see AI behave like that when confronted with difficult programming/hacking challenges. This is already reality.

I got to experience XPENG’s NGP on European roads for the first time, here in Paris. Super smooth, even with roadworks and traffic jams. I was surprised by how well it handled Paris traffic. XPENG and Tesla will be the only two automakers participating in the show’s official Autonomous Lab, offering supervised rides on public roads. Really enjoyed experiencing this firsthand. Looking forward to more FSD in europe!
